why: Entry selection must be unambiguous: `hermes run` without --workflow picks the single exported entry. Zero candidates means there is nothing to run; two means the choice is a coin flip and the artifact is not reproducible.
fix: mark exactly one exported workflow with `entry`
or pass --workflow <name> explicitly at run time
